newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BUNDS TO TRADE BETWEEN 101.50 AND 102.34.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BUNDS TO TRADE BETWEEN 101.50 AND 102.34.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will be barred from progress by the 102.34 level, but will maintain a base at 101.50, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"The contract has gapped lower with Treasuries overnight, and will probably mess around the 102.00 level," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch at London.
September Bunds were down 35 basis points at 101.87 at 0704 GMT. The contract could bob up to 102.10, Wilkin said, just below recent highs.
It slipped through intraday support at 101.92 earlier in the session.
Further intraday supports kick in at 101.82 and 101.59, Wilkin said.
"The key support level is at 101.50," Wilkin said.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell found intraday retracement support at 101.88, just above current session lows of 101.86.
"A break of 101.88 would allow tests of the 101.50/43 bear trigger," the bank said in a note to clients.

Further down, Wilkin saw key support at 100.93. This corresponds to the 100.94 June 20 low on daily charts, and is also the 61.8 percent retracement of the rally from the low of 99.32 on May 29 to the high of 103.52 on July 23.
Tuesday's high of 102.34 will provide a firm cap for the market, Wilkin said.
"If we push back to 102.34 and get back through there, we will have sideways action around 102.00 to 102.20. It may go to 102.50, but I'm not expecting it to go much higher."
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell found a minor congestion zone at 102.05/102.00, with further upside extension to 102.51.
December Euromarks slipped 0.03 to 96.45 at 0725 GMT.
"Sustained losses through 96.48 would indicate that the upside correction is complete, putting 96.44/43 into view, ahead of 96.38 minor trendline."
